name: RendererTextures
signature: public sealed class RendererTextures : IMaterialResources, IDisposable

docs.summary: The renderer's bindless textures and samplers. A texture gets a slot in the table of its type the first time a material or global uses it, and every world's frame table and every view's sampler table follow. Default textures (white, black, gray, normal, transparent, plus any the host registers) fill in for textures that are not set.
Slots in each of the 2D array, 3D, cube and cube array tables.
